integrity: Proof gives all-word Boolean identities and an explicit six-pair fooling-set lower certificate. Finite computations are reproducibility checks, not the basis for generality. Historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to epsilon-free two-state source NFAs with exactly one initial and one accepting state; target NFA may have multiple initial states. The binary lower example requires six target states. No claim for multi-endpoint sources or three-or-more-state sources.
title: Sharp six-state square-root bound for two-state singleton-endpoint NFAs
